content.rendered:
Friday, September 30th is the annual Archer Glen Fun Run Fundraiser. This is our school’s main Parent Advisory Committee’s (PAC) fundraiser for the year. PAC Fun Run monies helps to fund classroom field trips, transportation fees for field trips, classroom parties, school assemblies, special classroom book sets, library books, Biz Town for 5th grade and much, much more.

The Archer Glen students will be running laps on Friday to bring in support from family and friends.

Parents are welcome to come and cheer for their child. Parking is available in the AG parking lot. Please check-in at a table by the field and pick up a Visitor sticker.
